translations.web: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”
translations.bsb: But He told them, “I have food to eat that you know nothing about.”
translations.kjv: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
translations.asv: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not.
